02About me

A hands-on approach

I like taking a design
off the screen
and into the real world.

I’m a Mechanical Engineering graduate from Yaşar University, based in İzmir. My experience spans mechanical design, 3D modeling and technical drawings, with hands-on exposure to prototyping, quality control and production workflows.

Building a quadruped robot brought those areas together with embedded software, ROS and custom electronics. It also made me comfortable working alongside software and automation systems. I enjoy learning new tools and technologies and putting them to practical use.
